name: _Input Control
description: Private visual shell shared by Text Field and Search Field. Size is an internal composition axis; interaction, disabled, invalid, and focus presentation are derived from the descendant native input rather than a visual state prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Required private composition content, normally the descendant native input viewport.

props.name: size
props.description: Private shell height axis consumed only by parent design-system components.

anatomy.name: shell
anatomy.description: Private rounded surface and border wrapper.

anatomy.name: focus-ring
anatomy.description: CSS-derived focus presentation around the shell; never a focusable element.

states.name: hover
states.description: Derived from descendant input hover while enabled.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Derived from descendant input focus-visible state.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Derived from the descendant native disabled input.

semantics.accessibleName: none; the private shell does not own the field accessible name
semantics.keyboardActivation: none; the descendant native input owns keyboard interaction
semantics.focus: the shell never owns focus; it reflects descendant focus visually
requirements: Compact size remains 40 CSS pixels high using the governed 40px spacing token.
Default size remains 44 CSS pixels high using the governed 40px plus 4px spacing tokens.
The private shell does not synthesize input semantics, value, label, validation, or events.
Visual hover, focus, disabled, invalid, and invalid-focus states are derived from the descendant input rather than a state prop.
This internal contract must never create a public React package export.

content.description: Private parent components place their native input/content inside the shell.
